gate_cascade_analysis.root_cause: Gate evaluator read boolean field 'pre_test_fixed' as string 'True' rather than Python bool True in the first 3 attempts (GATE_BLOCK). The 4th attempt failed with artifact_not_updated_past_bootstrap. The 5th and 6th attempts were SKIP due to pre-test failures introduced by new tests added in .80. Two distinct bugs: (1) gate type coercion; (2) new-test regression breaking pre-test suite.
gate_cascade_analysis.gate_coercion_pattern: String 'true'/'false' vs boolean True/False is a persistent conductor bug. The gate evaluator must coerce string representations before comparison.
gate_cascade_analysis.pre_test_instability: New tests added during .80 (by Exp 1028 Preflight v30 which grew the suite from 88 to 132 passing) introduced at least one failing test that blocked the last 2 Triple Integration attempts.
gate_cascade_analysis.fix_needed: Two separate fixes required: (1) gate evaluator hardening to coerce string booleans; (2) pre-test stabilization pass to ensure new tests added in .80 do not leave any failures before .81 launches.

fover_expansion_analysis.root_cause: Z3 labeling succeeded for 85 pairs but metamorphic expansion produced 0 candidates — the metamorphic generator was not implemented or produced empty results. FoVer corpus at 85 pairs is insufficient to train ThinkPRM, GS-KAN, or NK-KAEM models with statistical reliability.
fover_expansion_analysis.downstream_impact: Exp 1033 (ThinkPRM) trained on CI stub model and produced AUROC=0.5 with delta=0.0 (no real learning). Exp 1034 (GS-KAN) scored below baseline (0.65 vs 0.6875). Exp 1036 (NK-KAEM) diverged. All three failures share the same root cause: insufficient labeled training data.
fover_expansion_analysis.fix_for_81: Implement metamorphic expansion in the FoVer generator; alternatively source additional pairs from external corpora. Gate all three accuracy experiments on n_total_pairs >= 200.

kv260_analysis.root_cause_hypothesis: Load Error -1 from fpgautil typically indicates FPGA manager rejected the bitstream — possible causes: (1) incorrect overlay format (dtbo vs bin); (2) firmware path mismatch; (3) version mismatch between bitstream and PL region. Requires offline diagnosis against the KV260 guide written by Exp 1037.
kv260_analysis.fix_for_81: Review KV260 guide artifact, test dtbo overlay application sequence offline, confirm correct firmware paths before next live attempt.

bottlenecks_identified: TRIPLE INTEGRATION GATE COERCION BUG (6 failed attempts): Gate evaluator read pre_test_fixed as string 'True' rather than Python bool True — caused 3 GATE_BLOCKs. Two separate failures then blocked 2 more attempts via pre-test regressions. Combined waste: ~90 min across all attempts. Fix is one line in the gate evaluator (coerce 'true'/'false' strings to bool before comparison).

FOVER CORPUS INSUFFICIENT (85 vs 500+ pairs): Metamorphic expansion produced 0 candidates — generator not implemented. This blocked real training for ThinkPRM (AUROC=0.5 CI stub), GS-KAN (below baseline), and NK-KAEM (diverged). Three experiments failed for the same root cause. Fix: implement metamorphic expansion, then gate all three on n_total_pairs >= 200.

DUALGPU LIVE INFERENCE BLOCKED BY WRONG TORCH BUILD (15TH CONSECUTIVE IDLE): torch 2.11.0+cpu is installed; ROCm variant needed. nvidia-smi confirms 2x RTX 3090. Live benchmark was one pip install away. Cumulative foregone savings: ~900 min across 15 milestones.

ESCALATE_OPUS FOR HARDWARE EXPERIMENTS (3 escalations): Exp 1035 (DualGPU ROCm), Exp 1037 (KV260), and Exp 1038 (retro) all hit Sonnet max-turns and required escalation to Opus 100 turns. Pre-emptive Opus routing for these classes is available (feat(routing) commit) but not yet activated in the conductor.

KV260 BITSTREAM LOAD ERROR -1: SSH reachable but fpgautil returned Load Error -1, likely dtbo format mismatch or PL firmware path issue. KV260 guide written by Exp 1037 provides recovery path; needs offline diagnosis before .81.

LEGACY CARRYOVERS FINAL APPEARANCE (accumulated waste before retirement): Exp 786 (77 min), Exp 641 (not in slowest-5 this time), Exp 906 (35 min) ran for the last time this milestone. The manifest fix was available for 20 consecutive milestones; delay cost ~2,618 min cumulative. Although now resolved going forward, this pattern of delayed governance action is a process anti-pattern to monitor.

CLOSED RETRO EXP 742 REAPPEARED (27 min waste): RETRO-033 was definitively closed in .57 yet Exp 742 ran again as a 200q GPU trial consuming 27 min. The conductor lacks a filter for experiments associated with closed RETROs in research-complete.yaml.

IN-PROCESS DOC RECONCILIATION AS SLOW EXPERIMENT (28 min): Exp 950 in-process doc pass ran as a full inline experiment consuming 28 min. Doc reconciliation passes should be async or batched to avoid consuming conductor wall time in the critical path.

PRE-TEST SUITE INSTABILITY AFTER EXPANSION (2 SKIPs): Preflight v30 added 44 new tests (88 → 132) but introduced at least one failing test that blocked Triple Integration's last two attempts. New tests must be verified green before being gated on. Pre-test stability checks must be a preflight criterion.
improvements_suggested: FIX GATE COERCION BUG (highest ROI for .81): Change gate evaluator to coerce string 'true'/'false' to bool before comparison. One-line fix. Would have saved ~90 min this milestone across Triple Integration's 6 failed attempts. Implement before .81 launches.

IMPLEMENT FOVER METAMORPHIC EXPANSION: The z3-only FoVer corpus is 85 pairs. Metamorphic expansion (input mutation + relabeling) can reach 500+ pairs without new model inference. Gate ThinkPRM, GS-KAN, and NK-KAEM on n_total_pairs >= 200 to prevent AUROC=0.5 CI stub runs.

INSTALL TORCH ROCM BEFORE DUALGPU EXPERIMENTS: torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 is the correct build per CLAUDE.md. One pip install command. Enables live inference benchmark on both RTX 3090s. Expected ~90 min/milestone throughput gain once DualGPU live inference is activated.

ACTIVATE PRE-EMPTIVE OPUS ROUTING FOR HARDWARE EXPERIMENTS: The feat(routing) differential agent routing commit provides this capability. Activate it for DualGPU, KV260, and multi-criterion retro experiments. Eliminates escalation overhead and prevents max-turns mid-experiment.

DIAGNOSE KV260 BITSTREAM LOAD ERROR OFFLINE: Review Exp 1037 KV260 guide artifact, test dtbo overlay format and firmware path against the KV260 documentation. Resolve offline before next live attempt in .81. Target: SSH + bitstream load succeeds in one conductor pass.

FILTER CLOSED-RETRO EXPERIMENTS FROM CONDUCTOR QUEUE: Add conductor pre-launch check: if experiment_id is in research-complete.yaml with retro_closed=True, block it from new milestone queues. Prevents Exp 742-class re-runs of closed experiments (27 min saved this milestone).

STABILIZE PRE-TEST SUITE BEFORE MILESTONE LAUNCH: After any preflight that adds new tests, run the full pre-test suite and verify 0 failures before activating the milestone. Exp 1028 expanded the suite but left at least one failing test that blocked Triple Integration. Preflight success criterion must include 'all new tests green'.

ASYNC OR BATCH DOC RECONCILIATION PASSES: In-process doc reconciliation (Exp 950-class, 28 min) should run async or be batched at milestone end rather than inline with the experiment queue. Moves non-blocking work off the critical path.

PLACE RETRO EXPERIMENT FIRST, NOT LAST: Exp 1038 (retro) was the last experiment and required ESCALATE_OPUS. Conductor barely reached it. Move the retro to experiment position 2 (after preflight) so it cannot be dropped if the conductor aborts early.

SOTA MODEL PRE-DOWNLOAD IN PREFLIGHT: Expand Exp 1028-class preflight to verify all three SOTA GGUFs are locally cached. Eliminates 20-30 min inline download overhead per GPU experiment. Already recommended in prior retros but not yet implemented.

estimated_time_savings.note: Exclusion manifest retirement of 786/641/906 is now REALIZED (saves 154 min/milestone starting from .81). Remaining near-term savings target remaining bottlenecks.

structural_wins_this_milestone: Exclusion manifest finally applied after 20 consecutive milestones of recommendations — Exp 786, Exp 641, Exp 906 permanently retired. This is the largest single governance improvement in project history.
YAML schema linter deployed (Exp 1026) — caught 2 prior_failures omissions in .79 roadmap; .80 roadmap scored 0 violations. Mechanical enforcement of planner discipline now in place.
Conductor supervisor deployed (Exp 1027) with 6 passing tests — orphan subagent detection and process isolation infrastructure now operational.
FR-11 self-distillation loop infrastructure closed end-to-end (Exp 1031) — the loop produces training examples even if energy filter AUROC needs improvement.
PPSEBM relay live (Exp 1032) — violation detection operational on live inference, just below the 0.7 AUROC target.

trend_analysis.note: Count reduction (597→441 experiments, -0.69 min/exp rate improvement) explains ~94% of the one-time improvement. The manifest retirement explains ~5.5% and will compound as a recurring structural saving in .81+. This is the first milestone where some improvement is confirmed structural.
